title: JJK RP Vault generator table file
description: A set of generator tables. Canon files live in data/canon/; your own files live in %APPDATA%/jjk-rp-vault/tables/ and are merged over canon by entry id — same id overrides, new id adds.

additionalProperties.title: Table
additionalProperties.description: The property name is the table id, e.g. "curse.form".

id.description: Unique within its table. Reusing a canon entry's id overrides that entry.

grades.description: Grades allowed to draw this entry. Omit to allow all.

tags.description: Free-form labels, used for coherence filtering between fields. On a pickable table such as technique.canonical, the first tag names the technique type to pin.

note.description: Subtitle shown when the entry is picked from a list rather than rolled. Never becomes part of the generated value.
